svg.aria-label: The homelab media setup: clients on desktop and mobile reach everything through an Nginx reverse proxy. Behind it, the Proxmox server runs Plex, Jellyfin, Sonarr, Radarr, Seerr, qBittorrent, Pi-hole, Minecraft and more, and mounts the Synology NAS over NFS, where /volume1/data holds the movies, TV, music and books.
